steps.en: The company owner's latest email address is obtained from the data source
steps.id: Alamat email terbaru owner perusahaan diambil dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The latest-email lookup is switched off by a setting, so the stored address is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian email terbaru dimatikan oleh setelan, jadi alamat yang tersimpan dipakai.

steps.en: Each unique company owner gets one combined email for their notices
steps.id: Setiap owner perusahaan unik menerima satu email gabungan untuk notice-nya
steps.why_en: One company can still receive several emails when its notices have different due dates.
steps.why_id: Satu perusahaan tetap bisa menerima beberapa email bila notice-nya beda tanggal jatuh tempo.

steps.en: Opted-out companies and companies without an email are not emailed
steps.id: Perusahaan yang opt-out atau tanpa email tidak dikirimi email

steps.en: The email lists the unpaid notices and mentions the first letter
steps.id: Email memuat daftar notice belum dibayar dan menyebut surat pertama
steps.why_en: The email wording is stored in the database and cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi email disimpan di database dan tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.

steps.en: The email is sent to the company owner
steps.why_en: Email sending for these reminders is switched off in the production settings and the scheduled run is off too.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman email pengingat ini dimatikan di setelan produksi dan proses terjadwalnya juga mati.
